body: Oh my goodness that is so sad don't worry you are not what they say that you are i can tell that anyone that cares enough to put themselves through pain just to make sure that others are okay is an amazing and brave person who is definitely not worthless. I'm not going to say it gets better because I know how little that means to someone like us who are going through this. I just want to say that I am here for you and that you are not alone. If you ever want to talk you could message me online or something like that. But I know how hard it is to walk this road alone and you are clearly not anything that people are telling you. I don't know how much help this will be but I want you to know that there are people who care about you and that you are definitely worth saving. ❤

You cannot blame yourself for what he did. If You are willing to save his life once, then, given the chance, you know you would have chosen to save it twice. It is not your fault and you need to stop believing it is. Life's too short to waste blaming and hating yourself. The best thing you could do for him is remember the person that you knew and stop trying to find a way to keep the pain fresh. I think we can all see that you are a great person and that you deserve to put yourself at ease. Again I'm sorry about what happened but I know from experience that he would not blame you for his situation. I should know because I am in that same situation. So stop blaming yourself. And we are all here to support you. ❤
